It receives two upgrades, one when the [[Mercenary Base]] is upgraded to Level 3 and one when upgraded to Level 6. It spawns next to the [[Mercenary Base]] and moves towards the entrance, whereupon it disappears. Whenever there is a detectable enemy in its range, it will stop moving to attack it. It will continue walking if there are no enemies in its range for a few seconds. When it detects an enemy, it will fire at it in a burst with a long cooldown. While it has no limit in regular gameplay, there is a limit of 10 '''Riflemen''' per [[Mercenary Base]] in [[PVP]]. ==Appearance== The '''Rifleman''' has dark skin. It has a light green shirt, green vest and cap, brown gloves and shoes, black belt and khaki pants. It wields an XM7. ==Statistics== {{neow| $DPS$ = (Damage * Burst Count) / (Cooldown + Aim Time + (Firerate * Burst Count)) $RAM$ = Health / Spawnrate $REF$ = DPS is calculated as (Damage × Burst Count) ÷ (Cooldown + Aim Time + (Firerate × Burst Count)).

}} ==Skins== ''To see all the upgrades of a skin, see the [[/Gallery#Skins|gallery]] page.'' {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:LiberatorRifleman0.png|175px]] |[[File:FrostRifleMerc0.png|175px]] |[[File:GraveyardRifleman0.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Deluxe|Liberator}} |{{Color|OperationICE|Frost Legion}} |{{Color|Null|Graveyard}} |- !Obtained From |[[Deluxe Crate]] |[[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Premium Battle Pass]] |[[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Premium Battle Pass]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Rifleman''' can be quite effective early on, as one will always spawn when the [[Mercenary Base]] is placed down and it has very good DPS for its cost. **However, do note that it does not have hidden or flying detection until the [[Mercenary Base]] is upgraded to Level 3, making it quite weak against hidden and flying enemies that appear early. ***Weaker hidden enemies like the [[Hidden]] can be killed through collision, though tougher ones like the [[Fallen Soul]] will easily overwhelm a Level 0 '''Riflemen'''. *The '''Rifleman's''' collision deals full damage to enemies with defense, though its gun does not. **You should not rely on this, as most of the '''Rifleman's''' DPS comes from its gun. *Later on, multiple upgraded '''Riflemen''' can be quite effective at clearing out enemies, due to their large range, quick spawnrate, hidden detection and decent DPS. **However, do note that it has the lowest health out of all [[Mercenary Base]] units, making it vulnerable to hordes of enemies or enemy abilities like the [[Fallen King]]'s ''Sword Swing''. ***The [[Field Medic]] can help by giving the '''Rifleman''' a shield and by healing its health. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''19 April 2024''' -
